agent.name: Special Dark Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance, contrary evidence and anti-hype qualification

analytical_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
general_et_finding: NOT YET EVALUABLE. Layer 1 stops on an unintegrated component; no system is demonstrated. Order-of-magnitude change NOT SCORED; widespread impact NOT SCORED; paradigm shift NOT SCORED; catalytic effect NOT SCORED; democratization NOT SCORED; irreversibility NOT SCORED. Do not substitute all generative AI or a repaired hypothetical system.
application_finding: The chart workflow is proposed and the specified component cannot establish its capability. Local benefit remains unmeasured.
organization_specific_finding: NOT YET EVALUABLE for the specified component. Request an assembled usable system before scoring or assigning a broader agentic-system label. The chart application remains a proposal; adding a hypothetical repair silently would change the unit. Financial permissions and human accountability do not disappear because the technology description is incomplete.

evidence.claim: Apply the sequential course instrument and distinguish facts, case premises and interpretation.
evidence.source_or_reference: S0 Chapter 11 sections 11.2 and 11.7; S1-S6 evidence/source_register.json
evidence.evidence_type: Course framework plus bounded original-source packet
evidence.notes: No source establishes chart-review outcomes. Candidate views are supplied analyses, not independent verification.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Evidence about assembled agent systems cannot establish this isolated component as a usable system.
A component could later join an important system; that possibility is not the missing present system evidence.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the described scope mismatch; classification and performance are undetermined for an unspecified assembled system. This is not a negative finding about all agentic AI.
value_opportunity_implication: Local value is undetermined until the assembled system and task are specified. No benefit or operational access is inferred.
risk_governance_implication: Silently substituting a different system creates false confidence. Preserve the scope stop and human authority.
recommendation_management_implication: NOT YET EVALUABLE: obtain the actual assembled system and comparator before classifying this unit. Do not recommend the primary system or authorize deployment by silently substituting it. This scope stop must survive integration.
change_monitoring_triggers: Requestor supplies a usable assembled system and comparator: reopen classification for that newly specified unit.
Evidence owner supplies dated capability and dependence evidence: distinguish a supported finding from a hypothetical repair.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request usable-system evidence, task boundary and the actual comparator. The component cannot inherit a parent technology label.
No proposed repair, permission or local benefit is assumed.
